#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'Usage: %s OUTPUT_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd -P)
log_root=$base/logs
out=$1

out_parent=$(dirname -- "$out")
mkdir -p -- "$out_parent"
out_parent=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$out_parent" && pwd -P)
out_abs=$out_parent/$(basename -- "$out")

case $out_abs in
    "$log_root"|"$log_root"/*)
        printf 'Refusing output directory inside %s\n' "$log_root" >&2
        exit 2
        ;;
esac

if [ -e "$out_abs" ] || [ -L "$out_abs" ]; then
    if [ ! -d "$out_abs" ] || [ -L "$out_abs" ]; then
        printf 'Output path must be a real directory: %s\n' "$out_abs" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    if [ -n "$(find "$out_abs" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then
        printf 'Output directory must be empty: %s\n' "$out_abs" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
else
    mkdir -- "$out_abs"
fi

stage=$(mktemp -d "$out_abs/.support-export.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -rf -- "$stage"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

redact_file() {
    sed -E \
        -e 's/[[:alnum:]_%+.-]+@[[:alnum:].-]+\.[[:alpha:]]{2,}/[REDACTED]/g' \
        -e 's/("auth_token"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)"[^"]*"/\1"[REDACTED]"/gI' \
        -e 's/(auth_token[[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:],;}]+/\1[REDACTED]/gI' \
        "$1" > "$2"
}

cd -- "$log_root"
find . -type d -print | while IFS= read -r rel; do
    [ "$rel" = . ] || mkdir -p -- "$stage/$rel"
done

find . -type f -print | while IFS= read -r rel; do
    src=$log_root/${rel#./}
    dst=$stage/$rel
    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$dst")"
    redact_file "$src" "$dst"
    chmod --reference="$src" "$dst"
    touch -r "$src" "$dst"
done

find . -type l -print | while IFS= read -r rel; do
    src=$log_root/${rel#./}
    target=$(readlink -f -- "$src" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case $target in
        "$log_root"/*)
            if [ -f "$target" ]; then
                dst=$stage/$rel
                mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$dst")"
                redact_file "$target" "$dst"
                chmod --reference="$target" "$dst"
                touch -r "$target" "$dst"
                printf 'Dereferenced safe in-tree symlink: %s\n' "$rel" >&2
            else
                printf 'Rejected non-file symlink: %s\n' "$rel" >&2
            fi
            ;;
        *)
            printf 'Rejected symlink outside logs/: %s\n' "$rel" >&2
            ;;
    esac
done

cp -R -- "$stage/." "$out_abs/"
rm -rf -- "$stage"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
chmod 755 bin/export
printf '%s\n' '--- UPDATED EXPORTER ---'
sed -n '1,240p' bin/export
printf '%s\n' '--- PRE-CHANGE SOURCE HASHES ---'
cat /tmp/privacy-export-before.sha256
